usedFor: gate tracks entries and their status, and Brevo stores the person through “Add Or Update Contact” when “Gate Status Changed”.

bestTemplate.name: “Gate Status Changed” in gate, then “Add Or Update Contact” in Brevo
bestTemplate.why: A status change in gate adds the contact to Brevo or refreshes an existing one.

watchOut: “Gate Status Changed” is polling, so Brevo updates after a scheduled check, not at the moment of change.
